title: Mandatory Pre-Booking Required for AquaDome Shows
impact: Standby lines for Aqua Action water performances in the forward AquaDome stretch around Deck 15 with zero guaranteed admittance without an app reservation.
mitigation: Book all AquaDome and Ice-skating show slots via the Royal Caribbean app at 00:01 on embarkation day.
evidence: Royal Caribbean Guest Entertainment Policy aboard Icon Class.
